factor_name: Breadth-conditioned trend residualized to cross-sectional volatility

calculation.expression: residualize((0.4*T20_volscaled + 0.6*T60_volscaled) * sign(2*B20-1)*abs(2*B20-1)^0.5 against lagged 40d volatility cross-section)
calculation.description: Blend 20- and 60-day volatility-scaled momentum, condition it on lagged 20-day breadth confidence, and remove the contemporaneous cross-sectional linear component explained by lagged 40-day volatility. All inputs are lagged before the forward test.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample result, but narrowly clears the ICIR gate; interpret conservatively in the 15-asset universe. Residualization reduced IC versus raw breadth-conditioned trend but remained above both admission thresholds.
